verdict.rationale: Linear's own homepage claims it automatically turns conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are routed, labeled and prioritized. The customer-requests docs add that feedback can be analyzed in bulk with Linear Agent, so this is a first-party feedback-to-issue capability. However, the evidence is marketing-level and does not show AI breaking one plain-language description into a structured set of several proposed tasks for review. missing for 10: documentation of AI decomposing a single feedback description into multiple structured task proposals, a review/approve step for proposed tasks, detailed first-party docs on the Linear Agent feedback flow, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI turn a plain-language feedback description into a structured set of proposed tasks

citations.quote: Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
analyze feedback in bulk with Linear Agent
